data.name: Gabriel
data.gender_notes: Gabriel is used as a male name in christian naming traditions.
data.short_meaning: God is my strength; mighty man of God
data.long_meaning: From the Hebrew gavri, 'my strength' or geber, 'man', + El, 'God' — 'God is my strength'. Its root is Hebrew g-b-r-ʾ-l. The archangel Gabriel (Daniel 8:16; Luke 1:19). Gabriel is a Hebrew name meaning “God is my strength; mighty man of God”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Gabriel expresses “God is my strength; mighty man of God”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Hebrew gavri, 'my strength' or geber, 'man', + El, 'God' — 'God is my strength'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Gabriel total 36, reducing to 9. Number 9 is associated with compassion, idealism and completion.
